page_title: FIO 2-2 BOL | Fiorentina v Bologna 26/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+9' Dodo (Fiorentina) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
90+8' One of the players from Fiorentina times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90+6' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) picks up a yellow card for a foul.
90+6' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Edin Dzeko (Fiorentina), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
90+6' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
90+4' 2 - 2 Goal! Moise Kean (Fiorentina) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Lukasz Skorupski to commit before slotting the penalty into the right of the goal.
90+4' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is going to take the penalty!
90+3' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Fiorentina!
90+2' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Fiorentina! Let's see what he decides.
90+1' A lofted pass picks out Moise Kean (Fiorentina) in space in the box, he beats the keeper with a low drive but it's blocked on the line by a defender.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
89' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is caught offside!
89' Bologna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
87' Federico La Penna shows a yellow card to Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
86' Daniel Niccolini has decided to substitute Jonathan Rowe and he is replaced by Nicolo Casale (Bologna).
85' That will be all from Luca Ranieri who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Roberto Piccoli (Fiorentina).
83' An infringement by Emil Holm (Bologna) results in a yellow card and as it's the second time today, he also sees a red and is dismissed by Federico La Penna.
82' The game is interrupted now, Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
80' Fiorentina fail to score from a corner as Lukasz Skorupski (Bologna) leaps to collect the ball.

80' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Fiorentina will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
76' Here is a change. Giovanni Fabbian is going off and Daniel Niccolini gives the last tactical orders to Tommaso Pobega (Bologna).
76' Federico Bernardeschi (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Riccardo Orsolini.
74' 1 - 2 Goal! Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Lukasz Skorupski into the bottom left corner.
73' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
72' Handball by Lewis Ferguson (Bologna). PENALTY to Fiorentina! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
72' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
71' The foul by Emil Holm (Bologna) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Federico La Penna.
69' The goal by Bologna is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
68' Celebrations by Bologna are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
66' Goal! Thijs Dallinga (Bologna) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:3.
65' The manager makes a subsitution with Abdelhamid Sabiri (Fiorentina) coming on for Hans Nicolussi Caviglia.
64' Daniel Niccolini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jonathan Rowe (Bologna) replacing Nicolo Cambiaghi.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Santiago Castro departs the field of play to be replaced by Thijs Dallinga (Bologna).
63' A quickly taken corner by Bologna.
62' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Bologna win a corner.
61' The resulting corner from Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
61' A pass into the penalty area from Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) is intercepted by the defence. Good work from Fiorentina as they win a corner.
60' Santiago Castro (Bologna) tries his luck with and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but it is blocked by one of the defenders.
58' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
58' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Lukasz Skorupski.
58' Emil Holm (Bologna) trips an opposition player and Federico La Penna signals a foul.
54' Juan Miranda (Bologna) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
54' The substitution has been made. Edin Dzeko (Fiorentina) has replaced Nicolo Fagioli.
54' Stefano Pioli has decided to make a change. Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) replaces Rolando Mandragora.
53' It is time for a substitution. Niccolo Fortini (Fiorentina) is on for Robin Gosens.
52' 0 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) was set free in the area by Emil Holm and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 0:2.
49' The ball goes out of play. Fiorentina are awarded a corner kick.
49' The Fiorentina players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Federico La Penna. NO PENALTY!
47' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Fiorentina as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
46' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) gets inside the box and tries to beat Lukasz Skorupski with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
46' Handball! A player from Bologna handled the ball. A penalty is awarded to Fiorentina!
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Federico La Penna has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 44:56.
41' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) will take the corner.
41' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Corner kick. Bologna will have an opportunity.
40' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Lukasz Skorupski to dive and make a save.
39' Remo Freuler (Bologna) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Federico La Penna ignores the protests.
38' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
36' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) is booked.
34' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
34' Surely that's handball by one of the Bologna players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
33' Santiago Castro (Bologna) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
30' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
30' The ball goes behind for a corner. Fiorentina will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
28' Referee Federico La Penna signals that the goal stands after the VAR review and the Bologna players have a reason to celebrate!
27' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Bologna goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
25' 0 - 1 Goal! Santiago Castro (Bologna) unleashes a first-time shot from inside the box and beats the goalkeeper into the top right corner. 0:1.
25' A corner kick by Bologna is thwarted by the well prepared David de Gea (Fiorentina).

24' Juan Miranda (Bologna) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball goes out of play and Bologna have been awarded a corner kick.
22' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
19' After the VAR review the referee signals NO PENALTY to Fiorentina, play can continue.
19' Referee Federico La Penna makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Fiorentina. Let’s see what happens!
18' Surely that's handball by one of the Fiorentina players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
18' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) prepares to take a corner kick.

18' Juan Miranda (Bologna) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by David de Gea, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball is out of play. Bologna win a corner kick.
15' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) makes a strong challenge and Federico La Penna blows for a foul.
13' The players claim that Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) handled the ball and it seems they are right.

12' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) attacks the corner from Hans Nicolussi Caviglia in the centre of the box, but his header lacks accuracy and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Bologna will have a goal kick.
11' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Fiorentina) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
11' Dodo (Fiorentina) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Fiorentina have a corner.
10' Dodo (Fiorentina) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bologna.
8' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Moise Kean (Fiorentina) heads on.
6' Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
3' Nicolo Cambiaghi (Bologna) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
1' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Bologna will take the kick-off.
Federico La Penna got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
